states.NATIVE_HOST_VALIDATED: true for the harness host (JavaScriptCore, CryptoKit HMAC, Keychain, file store with protection, process death, locked device, reinstall); HealthKit background delivery, watch observations and a real synced week are NOT validated (no native implementation yet)

hostDependencies.runtime: JavaScriptCore, one JSVirtualMachine and one JSContext on one serial queue; the bundle is one classic script (build/link.mjs), floor iOS 16

hostDependencies.store: store.mjs contract {load, commit(id, expectedVersion, doc), remove, tombstone, tombstoneOf, raw}; anchor {get, set, clear}

g07Claim: An erasure is never read as recovery or readiness for every clinical hold (an erased hold leaves a marker that holds until a valid readiness declaration, whatever the clock). Not for a 'not 100%' report that opened no hold (SEC-FPV-01): its question goes with the erasure and only the native obligation N-3 keeps sessions from being startable until a new screen.
maintenanceRules: No planned change to CoachingCore before the V1 launch.

Exceptions only for a real safety defect, a proven incompatibility, an integrity failure, or a bug that makes an essential journey impossible; each needs a reproduction, a focal fix, the full regression, the device equivalence rerun and the competent reviews, and a successor record of this one.
Forbidden: new sporting features, optional refactors, prescription expansion, generic audits, intermediate freezes, a new engine architecture, unauthorised dose changes.
Further coach development happens on a successor line; this release stays as frozen.
Any app bundle must carry exactly the bound CoachingCore modules and replay core.json, int.json and final.json on the device with 0 DIVERGED.
reopeningCriteria: a reproduced safety defect (a hold released, a stop or adverse signal lost, an erasure read as readiness, a prescription shown during a hold)
a reproduced integrity failure (a forged or altered record accepted, a lost or doubled record)
a reproduced DIVERGED step between Node and JavaScriptCore in prescription, safety or the canonical record
a proven incompatibility with the iOS host or the native store contract
an essential journey impossible (onboarding, logging, review, hold and readiness, restart, erasure)
the R7-B0 records' review_by (2027-04-30) without an SSCTR renewal
realAthleteGates: D1 implemented and verified on the device
SEC-INT-05 rest and SEC-INT-12 schema tests
HealthKit background delivery and a real synced week
no payload in logs or crash reports
